profile.summary:
Hi! I'm Cindy 👋 I recently graduated UC Berkeley with a B.A. in Computer Science as a Regents' and Chancellor's Scholar. With experience across software engineering, product management, and leadership, I'm at my best when working at the intersection of engineering, product, and business, collaborating across teams to build thoughtful, impactful software.

✉️ cindysanchez@berkeley.edu
